## Texts and drawings (7)

- **E0787** (poem, likely): 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 双寿寺 诗序 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆, after 1761 · S220 section 一; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 乾隆庚辰岁八月，皇上五旬万寿，明年辛巳十有一月，圣母皇太后七旬万寿，百灵禔祉，三辰合庆。公即园之西圃辟选佛场，敬效人天釐祝。
  Fuheng founds a temple in the west of his garden for the birthdays of 1760 and 1761. S220's two bracketed year glosses are removed here. S220, after 张恩荫, takes it as the older 延寿寺.
- **E0917** (text, likely): 内务府 repair list 乾隆四十三年 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆四十三年 1778 · S220 section 三; archive not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 明善堂后碧涛书屋、双寿寺、眺吟楼、浩然亭、松风萝月等处捞堆坍塌山石泊岸、码头，勾抿油灰
  Earliest dated mention of these places. Settles the plan readings of QC53 松风萝月 and QC54 眺吟楼, both partly unread on S01.
- **E0788** (poem, guess): 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 环秀亭 诗序 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up · S220 section 三; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 自芝径桥舟行经？公主府折而北，筼筜夹岸，藤萝褭空，结环秀亭，达于长彴，是为北海子会合长河之水。膏渟黛蓄，沈沈无声，鸿俦雁侣时出没于蓼汀葭渚间，明湖秋涨，水阔云多。
  Bamboo banks and reed shallows on the way north. The ? stands in the page as fetched. 环秀 later names the east city gate of 延寿寺 (S42 snippet), hence the guess.
- **E1011** (description, sure): Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over. c. 2011 · 系列06 repost, status table · S356. https://blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_c27029650101itzz.html
  Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.
- **E0626** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 清夏斋. 2020 edition · v4 p.304 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=307
  Two courts side by side on land with a long history (裕亲王's 萼辉园 c. 1687, then 交辉园, 春和园, Prince Cheng's 西爽村 from 1773 to 1799). East is 延寿寺, first 双寿寺, renamed 竹林院 by Jiaqing: front hall three bays, rear hall five. West is 清夏斋: seven-bay 工字 hall, its plaque 凤麟洲 until 1804, with 天临海镜, 镜虹馆 and the cup-floating pavilion 寄情咸畅.
- **E0789** (drawing, sure, search index only): 延寿寺平面图. not seen · mhymy 样式雷图档; url not captured · S42. https://www.mhymy.com/tag/538
  Entry: 延寿寺, also called 竹林院; north gate plaque 竹林院, east city gate plaque 环秀; 喜雨山房 lies to the north-east; stream on the east and south. S220 ties 环秀城关 and the older 双寿寺 to the same area.
- **E0790** (drawing, sure, search index only): 延寿寺平面图. S310. https://www.mhymy.com/tag/538
  Plan of Yanshou Si, also called Zhulin Yuan; own page URL, shelf number and date not seen. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 延寿寺, 3x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
